scientific.integrity: The two source WNGrad accumulator index conventions are normalized on an isotropic quadratic. Exact objective ratios give the half-curvature barrier; monotonicity plus telescoping radius identities prove finite escape, bounded learned scale, and global convergence from every positive initial scale.
limitations: Both displayed source accumulator conventions are analyzed separately.
The transient-count bound is explicit but not claimed pointwise optimal.

title: WNGrad has a sharp half-curvature stabilization barrier
